# routeros_routing_fantasy (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the synthetic route generator entry.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___ts___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `dealer_id` (String) Identifier of the generator that hands out the synthetic routes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `dst_address` (String) The base destination prefix the generated routes start from. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway assigned to the generated routes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `instance_id` (String) Identifier of the generator instance. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `offset` (String) The offset applied to the generated destination prefixes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `prefix_length` (String) The prefix length of the generated destination prefixes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `priv_offs` (String) Offset of the private part of the generated route data. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `priv_size` (String) Size of the private part of the generated route data. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `route_count` (String) The number of synthetic routes generated by this entry. Maps to the RouterOS `count` property. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `scope` (String) The route scope assigned to the generated routes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `seed` (String) The seed of the pseudo random generator that produces the routes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `target_scope` (String) The target scope assigned to the generated routes. The value domain of this property could not be established, the RouterOS console offers no completions for it and the menu is undocumented. Supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `use_hold` (Boolean) Keep the generated routes in the hold state. The console reports `yes` and `no` as the accepted values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
